question: Thakkar Bapa was a dedicated social worker and freedom fighter primarily known for his lifelong efforts towards the upliftment and welfare of which section of Indian society?
solution: The correct answer is __**Tribal (Adivasi) communities**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Thakkar Bapa**, born as **Amritlal Vithaldas Thakkar** in **1869**, was a prominent **social worker** and **freedom fighter** in India. • He is primarily known for his lifelong efforts towards the **upliftment and welfare of the Tribal (Adivasi) communities**, focusing on their education, healthcare, and social empowerment. • Thakkar Bapa founded the **Bhil Seva Mandal** in **1922**, which aimed to improve the socio-economic conditions of the Bhil tribe in Gujarat and nearby regions. • He worked closely with **Mahatma Gandhi** during India’s freedom struggle and was deeply influenced by Gandhi’s philosophy of non-violence and rural development. • His efforts to bring attention to the plight of tribal communities led to the formation of specific policies and programs for their welfare post-independence.
